content.value: A double jet pelton wheel has a specific speed of 14 and is required to deliver 1000 kW. 17 The turbine is supplied through a pipeline from a reservoir whose level is 400 m above the nozzles. Allowing 5% for friction loss in the pipe calculate (i) speed in rpm, (ii) diameter of jet and (iii) mean diameter of bucket circle. Take $\mathrm { C _ { v } } = 0 . { \dot { 9 } } 8 ,$ , speed ratio = 0.46 and overall efficiency = 85%.
